title: Petra and the Colony
author: Tamsin Sandoval
blurb: Astrid Nystrom, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
